GateNow

Simplifying federal grant applications
for transportation infrastructure.

GateNow is a U.S. federal grant management
platform built to streamline the full lifecycle
of grant programs — from application to award.

What We Do

GateNow connects applicants with federal funding opportunities across transportation, infrastructure, and community development sectors.

Our platform handles eligibility checks, proposal submissions, multi-stage reviews, and award tracking in one unified workflow.

Compliance

All grant programs administered through GateNow comply with OMB Uniform Guidance (2 CFR Part 200) and federal transparency requirements.

Data is protected under FISMA standards and accessible only to authorized personnel.
